nom: Neutrogena Evenly Clear Retinoid Adapalene Gel 0.1%

segments.oily: One reviewer who describes herself as having oily skin says she kept getting acne despite consistent use and that the product was not for her.
segments.dry: The couple of reviewers who mention dry or dull skin report the product left their skin smoother and more hydrated with regular use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report positive results, including skin that feels more elastic and plump, and one reviewer says this was the first adapalene formula that did not cause stinging or burning on her combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report the product does not irritate their skin and is gentler than other retinoids or acne treatments they have tried, though one reviewer with sensitive skin says it dried her skin out and irritated certain areas.
segments.mature: One reviewer who describes reaching an age where her skin feels less youthful says the product did not agree with her skin and caused her to break out, leading her to discontinue use.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers report visible anti-aging effects, including softened fine lines and skin that feels plumper and more elastic with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report no dryness, especially when they follow up with a moisturizer, while a similar number describe some dryness, tightness, flaking or peeling, usually mild and temporary as skin adjusts, or say they now need to stay extra moisturized to manage it.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report little to no irritation and say the formula is gentler than other retinoids they have tried, including prescription-strength ones; however some report burning, stinging, tingling or peeling on first use that eases with time, and one reviewer had a severe reaction with red, peeling, burning skin.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report that acne marks, dark spots or old scarring fade or become less visible with continued use, though one reviewer says she has not yet seen any effect on older scars or discoloration.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster-clearing pimples or generally clearer skin with regular use, including some with hormonal or stubborn adult acne; a number of reviewers report the opposite, including breaking out after starting the product, seeing no real improvement, or acne getting worse initially.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight gel that absorbs quickly, no residue
Small tube relative to the packaging
A little goes a long way
Layers well under moisturizer and makeup

extraits.texte: I wanted to love this product because I love Neutrogena in general. However, after a couple of nights of use, my skin was basically sunburned without any sun. It turned red and peeled and was on FIRE! I never have any reactions so I was really surprised this bothered me so badly.

Overall, I didn't see much of a difference a difference in my skin after using it consistently for more than 1 weeks. I was still getting acne even though I was applying this retinoid. As a oily skin girl, it isn't for me.

The product feels nice as a moisturizer, but I did feel like it dried my skin out a bit. I didn't notice any changes or improvement from using this product. It seemed to irritate certain areas on my face. I have pretty sensitive skin, so I probably wouldn't recommend for those skin types. Overall didn't see any noticeable difference in using it.

I was so thankful to learn that you could get such an amazing product without the need for a prescription! I've struggled with acne all of my life and this product has truly helped not only clear my acne, but it's lessened the appearance of previous acne "scarring" that I've had for awhile as well! The tube looks rather small but it only takes the smallest amount to thinly layer over your skin (right after cleansing) so a little goes such a long way! You only need to use it once a day and I saw slight results only within several days of using but within as little as three months you should see even the bigger benefit! My teens love this as well and it will definitely stay a part of our everyday skincare routine! I've always trusted, and loved, the Neutrogena brand and this product does not disappoint!

I absolutely loved this product. It was so light on application I kept second guessing myself if I had put any on. This really softened the surface of my skin, and my skin feels like it has more elasticity and also more plump. I love how this really worked for me. My skin type is combination with no sensitivities or allergies of any kind. I highly recommend giving this a try if you feel like what you're using is failing you. This will not. Hope this helps any girly looking for something that works and has the same skin background I do.

I've been using this daily for over a week now. So far my skin is feeling smoother and hydrated. I have an issue with dry or dull skin. I see so far a gently glow so I'm excited of what it will be if I continue to use daily for months. Definitely recommend it. It's a high quality formula. No stickiness or residue

extraits.titre: Gentle enough for my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I have been on a journey on finding retinoids that would work on my sensitive and combination skin. Most of the adapalene brands have caused stinging and burning feeling but this one worked very well with my skin and it didn't cause redness or irritation. I'm already planning on buying a refill soon.
